Mirror Photo Booth

Tap, Pose, and Capture the Moment

Our Mirror Photo Booth is a full-length interactive magic mirror with a colourful RGB light frame. Guests walk up, tap the mirror, follow the fun on-screen animations and prompts, pose, and capture the moment — an elegant, interactive centrepiece for weddings, parties, and events.

Choose the format that fits your event:

Digital — $500 for 2 hours, each additional hour $125. Guests receive a digital gallery with instant sharing (no printed photos).

Printed — $600 for 2 hours, each additional hour $150. Unlimited photo prints on site plus digital copies, with a custom print design.

An attendant is included to run the booth, guide guests, and provide props. A backdrop, props, and setup and takedown are included. 2-hour minimum. Indoor setup preferred; power access required. Delivery extra.

An interactive full-length mirror photo booth for weddings, birthdays, graduations, corporate events, and community celebrations in Nova Scotia.
